scenes.visibleThesis: Giving reasons and answering doubts leaves the friend free to say no.

treatment.subjectRequirement: two friends choosing between restaurant options without readable menus
treatment.environment: ordinary restaurant-planning conversation at a table with two distinct place cards kept text-free
treatment.composition: one friend contributes reasons in conversation with an open hand while the other considers two equal, reachable options
treatment.camera: documentary eye-level two-person view with both options and the considering gesture visible
treatment.action: the friend hears reasons and doubts answered while keeping both choices available

semantic.actorAction: the friend considers the reasons and keeps the ability to say no
semantic.cause: Friends give reasons and answer doubts about a restaurant choice
semantic.consequence: The friend keeps the ability to say no
semantic.buyerInterpretation: the friend sees that the decision remains theirs
evidenceAnchors: If you suggest a restaurant to friends, you give reasons, answer doubts, and try to convince them.

scenes.visibleThesis: Relevant information and room for questions leave the customer free to decline.

treatment.subjectRequirement: a customer and a professional in a text-free consultation
treatment.environment: quiet one-to-one consultation table with two open, text-free information cards
treatment.composition: the customer examines the information cards, asks a question, and keeps an open path away from the table
treatment.camera: documentary three-quarter view showing the customer, the information, and the unblocked departure path
treatment.action: the customer reviews relevant information, asks a question, and remains free to decline

semantic.actorAction: the customer reviews information, asks questions, and remains free to decline
semantic.cause: The customer gets relevant information and room for questions
semantic.consequence: The customer has genuine freedom to decline
semantic.buyerInterpretation: the customer can make an informed free decision
evidenceAnchors: The customer gets relevant information, room for questions, and genuine freedom to decline.

scenes.visibleThesis: An informed customer can say yes or no freely.

treatment.subjectRequirement: a customer considering a clear offer with a professional listening nearby
treatment.environment: calm consultation setting with one text-free offer card and open space around the customer
treatment.composition: the customer holds the information card, faces the professional, and keeps an unobstructed route to leave or continue
treatment.camera: documentary eye-level view with the customer’s deciding gesture and open space visible
treatment.action: the customer makes an informed choice while the professional leaves the decision free

semantic.actorAction: the customer makes an informed choice and remains free to say no
semantic.cause: Healthy selling does not eliminate the no
semantic.consequence: Healthy selling makes the yes informed and free
semantic.buyerInterpretation: the customer understands that yes or no remains their decision
evidenceAnchors: The customer gets relevant information, room for questions, and genuine freedom to decline.
Healthy selling does not eliminate the no. It makes the yes informed and free.

scenes.visibleThesis: Understanding the need lets the professional present a relevant solution.

treatment.subjectRequirement: a professional listening to a customer in a text-free consultation
treatment.environment: quiet consultation table with a customer context object and one separate solution sample
treatment.composition: the customer indicates the context object while the professional keeps the solution sample separate until the need is understood
treatment.camera: documentary three-quarter consultation view with the listening gesture and both objects visible
treatment.action: the professional listens to the customer’s need before presenting the solution

semantic.actorAction: the professional understands the need before presenting a solution
semantic.buyerInterpretation: the customer sees that the solution follows the need

scenes.visibleThesis: A clear explanation of value lets the customer decide.

treatment.subjectRequirement: a professional explaining one text-free value sample to a customer
treatment.environment: calm one-to-one conversation with one text-free value sample between both people
treatment.composition: the professional explains the value sample with an open hand while the customer considers it without pressure
treatment.camera: documentary eye-level two-person view with the explanation and customer response visible
treatment.action: the professional explains the value clearly and asks the customer for a decision

semantic.actorAction: the professional explains the value clearly and asks for a decision
semantic.cause: You get to explain the value clearly
semantic.buyerInterpretation: the customer can consider the clear explanation before deciding
evidenceAnchors: You get to explain the value clearly and ask for a decision.
